text:
Maya Lopez: Quick check-in on the circuit-breaker + model-tiering work from the kernel selection RFC. We promised a post-RFC rollout plan for per-model circuit-breakers and fallback mapping. Where do we land on gating rules? 
Samir Patel: short answer: canary -> threshold -> auto-fallback. suggest starting with 5% traffic canary per model variant. 
Ben Chu: +1. also need a flag at runtime for 'fallback_override' per model id. That lets customer teams force old kernel if regressed. 
Ollie: telemetry question — do we emit event when circuit trips? need counts + p95 latency + error-rate in one metric to avoid noisy flips. 
Gloria Ramos: agree. propose a single composite metric `fallback_signal` = weighted( p95, err_rate, kv-miss-rate ). threshold tuned per model. 
Maya Lopez: how do we store per-model thresholds? env flag? per-model config store? 
Ben Chu: per-model config stored in config DB (we already have model_profiles table). add columns: `cb_enabled`, `cb_threshold`, `cb_cooldown_s`, `fallback_kernel`. patch below:
```sql
ALTER TABLE model_profiles ADD COLUMN cb_enabled bool DEFAULT false;
ALTER TABLE model_profiles ADD COLUMN cb_threshold float DEFAULT 0.75; -- normalized
ALTER TABLE model_profiles ADD COLUMN cb_cooldown_s int DEFAULT 300;
ALTER TABLE model_profiles ADD COLUMN fallback_kernel text DEFAULT 'kernel_v1';
```
Samir Patel: love it. For rollout: we should implement a circuit-breaker state machine in runtime: CLOSED -> OPEN -> HALF_OPEN with cooldown and sample-based half-open. config-driven. 
Ollie: ops note: add a flood-suppression window to avoid cascade on infra blips. also add opt-in metric 'cb_debug' for a model to emit raw signals. 
infra-bot: deploy bot: Deployment started for runtime-service v2.14.0 to canary (instance group: runtime-canary) — 1723456902
Gloria Ramos: compatibility: fallback_kernel must be compatible model format and quantization. add validation step in config API. if incompatible, reject and surface to team. 
Maya Lopez: good catch. Also need audit logs for every automatic fallback and manual override. Product asked for CSV export per customer. 
Ben Chu: can add event sink to pubsub on each fallback event with payload: model_id, from_kernel, to_kernel, reason, metrics_snapshot. 
Samir Patel: decision points: 1) per-model config in model_profiles 2) composite metric + defn 3) runtime CB state machine 4) audit/pubsub events 5) canary rollout at 5% -> 20% -> 100% 6) manual override flag. agree? 
All: :thumbsup: 
Maya Lopez: action items: Ben to send DB migration PR today, Ollie to add telemetry schema, Samir to prototype state machine, Gloria to spec validation rules, I'll draft rollout doc and coordinate canary start next Tue. 
Samir Patel: I can own the canary runbook. small note: add a kill-switch that forces all fallback to OFF for enterprise tiers (we need a toggle). 
Maya Lopez: yes add `cb_force_off` cluster-level flag. 
Ben Chu: sending PR link shortly. 
Maya Lopez: thanks everyone — will follow up with doc and timeline. ping me if you hit blockers. :rocket:
